phases.name: Foundation
phases.goal: A Hugo site styled like eltonminetto.dev is live on a staging subdomain with bilingual scaffolding, home, about, and 404 pages.
successCriteria: Staging subdomain serves a single-column, sans-serif, light-background Hugo site inspired by eltonminetto.dev.
Hugo native i18n is configured with content/pt-br and content/en and a visible language switcher.
Home and About render in both languages.
The switcher shows an only-in-PT/EN badge when a translation is missing instead of hiding or redirecting away.

creates.description: Hugo site configuration — bilingual pt-BR/en, PaperMod theme, minimal single-column aesthetic
Netlify build + per-context environment — pinned Hugo 0.170.1, context-aware baseURL, submodule checkout
Bilingual language switcher with orphan-aware only-in-X badge

phases.name: Content Migration
phases.goal: Every WordPress post, page, and image is versioned in the Hugo repo and renders on staging, including Recomendacoes sub-pages and the TCC/ClassGenerator pair.
successCriteria: All WordPress posts are converted to Markdown with front-matter (title, date, tags, language) under content//posts/.
All WordPress media is downloaded and versioned under static/images/ and referenced from Markdown.
Recomendacoes renders with sub-pages for Books/Cafes, Kitesurf, Musica, Sites e Podcasts, Posts Especiais, and Arte em SP where content exists.
TCC/ClassGenerator exists in both PT and EN variants as standalone pages.

creates.description: 107 WordPress posts migrated to Hugo page bundles — 103 PT + 4 EN, bilingual
134 WordPress media assets migrated (HEIC→JPEG, VideoPress self-hosted, images under year/month paths)
Recomendações PT branch bundle with 9 sub-pages (livros, música, kitesurf, sites-e-podcasts, posts-especiais, cafés, arte em SP, viagem pra Belém, artigos-tech)
TCC/ClassGenerator PT page with EN pair at content/en/thesis-classgenerator/ via shared translationKey, PDF at static/assets/

needs.description: Hugo site configuration — bilingual pt-BR/en, PaperMod theme, minimal single-column aesthetic

phases.name: SEO Preservation and Cutover
phases.goal: marcelioleal.com serves the Hugo site without breaking inbound links and WordPress is decommissioned.
successCriteria: Every WordPress post URL is either preserved as the same slug on Hugo or served via a 301 redirect.
A Netlify _redirects file covers every slug change and is verified end-to-end with a crawler.
DNS of marcelioleal.com points at Netlify production and WordPress is turned off.
Google Search Console reports no new 404 errors after the cutover window.

creates.description: Netlify _redirects file mapping legacy WordPress URLs to Hugo URLs
Production deployment serving marcelioleal.com with WordPress decommissioned
